evidence_items.claim: Mizuho is a clearing member of JSCC (Japan Securities Clearing Corporation), which launched CDM-based reporting in production in June 2025
evidence_items.excerpt: JSCC is the first CCP globally to deploy CDM in production. Mizuho as a major Japanese clearing member is connected to this CDM infrastructure.
evidence_items.caveats: JSCC CDM adoption does not necessarily indicate Mizuho internal CDM strategy. Clearing members can interface through vendor solutions.

evidence_items.claim: Mizuho is listed as a sponsor of ISDA Annual General Meeting events
evidence_items.excerpt: Mizuho appears as sponsor/participant in ISDA events, demonstrating engagement with derivatives industry standards.
evidence_items.caveats: Event sponsorship does not indicate technical CDM implementation.

null_results.implication: No public announcements of CDM adoption. Suggests relying on vendor/infrastructure solutions without native build.
No open source contributions to CDM projects.

classification.rationale: Classified OBSERVER (CCP-Connected) based on indirect connection to JSCC CDM infrastructure. No direct bank-level CDM implementation evidence.
